# HexPiece 3.3.5

The second of your new fruits: **the Supa Supa no Mi** (Daz Bones' Blade-Blade fruit), Uncommon, in the Devil Fruits tab. Not tested
in game yet: the build and all tests pass, every blade and cut was rendered from every side (third and first person, bare and with
Haki) and every sound was checked.

**The blades are made of your katana steel.** After you said the first blades looked poor, every blade on the body is now the real steel
of your Silver Crane katana (its own texture, lighting and shine), reshaped broad with Daz's wavy edge. With Armament Haki on they turn
the same very dark purple as your katanas, coming on gradually just as theirs do.

**How it plays** (fruit mode, keys as every fruit; the animations are ones the mod already had)
- **Left click: Spar Claw.** Your fingers grow steel claws: every swing rakes whoever is in front of you, one way then the other.
- **Right click: Flying Slash.** A blade grows from your forearm and you throw a crescent of cutting force that flies level and cuts
  through everyone in its path. Hold to charge (both arms out, blades out): it grows much bigger, longer and stronger.
- **Z: Atomic Spar.** Both arms turn to blades and cross: an X of cutting force flies out.
- **X: Spiral Hollow.** Blades spin round your forearms like drills and you charge about 12 blocks forward, drilling through everyone in
  the line, leaving a spiralling wake.
- **C: Atomic Spurt.** Blades grow from your feet and you skate very fast for 3.5 seconds, cutting whoever you pass and leaving skate
  marks on the ground.
- **V: Spider.** Your whole body turns to polished steel for 8 seconds: blows glance off you with sparks, you are not knocked back, a bare
  fist that hits you gets cut, and you move a little slower. Haki-coated blows still get through.
- **B: Sparkling Daisy.** Both arm blades out, you lunge straight through the one you are looking at, cutting them as you pass (an X
  flashes on them).
- **N: Spar Break.** Blades burst out all round your body and spin like a saw, cutting everyone around you, ending in a burst that throws
  them away.
- **Passive: Slashing Immunity.** Swords, axes and katanas cannot cut you unless they are coated in Armament Haki: they glance off.
- Each move spends fruit energy. With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the Conqueror's lightning comes off every cut that lands, and
  out of Spar Break's final burst.

**Sounds:** all from Freesound (CC0), none made by hand and none with a ring or a tune in it (a steel "shing" rings, so blades are heard as
swishes, scrapes and cuts): a blade swish, a knife scraping as blades come out, a stab, a sword striking armour for a glance, cloth
tearing, ice skating while you skate and a spinning swirl while Spar Break spins. A crowd cut at once is one or two sounds, not twenty.
